items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: But Glenn and his wife liked music, and musicians liked his barbecue place, and there was a back room...

ctx.x: ...(?)... music club and a barbecue restaurant. But Glenn and his wife liked music, and musicians liked his barbecue place, and there was a back room...

Right, it had a piano there. So they just started making the scene. It just happened, you know, on its own, more or less -- spontaneously. And a lot of great players used to come through there and make music.
